notes.title: HAPPY HALLOWEEN SALES 30%
notes.content:
Mindless creatures trotting through darkness, driven by simplistic goals, manipulated by forces beyond their comprehension...

- Enjoy simple yet challenging gameplay as you solve twisting puzzles by rotating tiles to connect paths and apply special powers.
- Avoid dozens of obstacles, monsters, and traps that try to slow you down. 
- Keep trying without dying! Failure is not an option, but mistakes lead to even more puzzles. 
- Discover and unlock tons of achievements such as secondary goals, mysterious unlockables, secret levels with unique game mechanics, and more!
- Explore an adorable world and meet a slew of unforgettable characters.

notes.title: Hello our dear fans and watchers!
notes.content:
[b]How are you?[/b]
Molecats are feeling good a month after release, and the team is preparing a polishing update! So, we need more feedback from you! If you feel you have a good suggestion about the game, please feel free to share it with us. Report any bugs you’ve encountered, any complaints about Molecats behaviour are also welcome! 
The team tried to provide as many languages as we could to the release date, but if you think that the game should be translated into the missing language, please let us know!

Also, don’t forget you can write a review (even a little one, even if negative). We really need your reviews for a future updates to improve the game!
We need you!
[i]And thank you kindly for support! <3[/i]

notes.content: インダイレクトコントロールのタイルを回転させるパズルアドベンチャー...　トラップ付き！ゴールは、洞窟の中でMolecatsの行くコースを変えて、コントロールしながらMolecatsをガイドすること。行く先々で、Molecatsは危険な罠や恐ろしいモンスター、トリッキーなチャレンジに遭遇するでしょう。

notes.title: Molecats Now Available on Steam as a Full Release!
notes.content:
Molecats is arriving today on Steam after a productive season on Early Access!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30372030/7edd20756b7e248c44a060237a5a3e9b7486fc17.png[/img]
In the game, your job is to help the aforementioned Molecats secure ever-important foodstuffs (‘shrooms) and loot (relics). Guide them through dangerous underground tunnels by twisting and turning tiles – indirectly controlling where and how your crew tackles each challenge. Ruthless monsters and traps are lurking around every corner: Take your time and plan each move carefully to keep those Molecats smiling. Of course, finding the exit with both goodies and limbs intact is great – but stay on the lookout for achievements, secondary goals, unlockables, secret levels, and more. You never know what you’ll dig up...

The game supports Mac, Windows, and Linux.

Thank you all for waiting all this years! Cheers!


Molecats Team
